name: usage-meter
description: Warns Claude, and you, as your claude.ai plan's 5-hour and 7-day usage limits fill up, so work reaches a clean stopping point before the limit cuts it off.

enabled.title: Warnings
enabled.description: Tell Claude (and you) when usage passes a threshold. /usage-meter off and on pause and resume the warnings without changing this.

marks.title: Thresholds
marks.description: Percent of the 5-hour window at which the main conversation is told, once each per window. Comma-separated.

agentMarks.title: Subagent thresholds
agentMarks.description: Percent of the 5-hour window at which a subagent is told to wrap up; at the highest it is told to stop and report. Empty for never.

skipAgents.title: Subagent types to leave alone
skipAgents.description: Subagent types never warned, such as "Explore, Plan". * matches anything, as in "my-plugin:*". Empty (the default) warns every subagent.

stopAt.title: Stopping point
stopAt.description: The percent of the 5-hour window where Claude should be at a stopping point. The wording of every warning follows it.

instruction.title: What to do at the stopping point
instruction.description: Told to Claude at the stopping point, in your words. Empty for the built-in text.

weeklyMarks.title: 7-day thresholds
weeklyMarks.description: Percent of the 7-day window at which the main conversation is told. Empty (the default) for no weekly warnings.

template.title: Custom message
template.description: Replaces the main conversation's warning. Placeholders: {used} {window} {resets} {mark} {stopAt} {instruction} {context}. Empty for the built-in wording.

toast.title: Show a notice
toast.description: Show you a short notice whenever Claude is warned.

showStatus.title: Status entry
showStatus.description: Keep the 5-hour and 7-day figures under the prompt, such as "5h 42% · 7d 12%".
